title: The Zong Breaking Pill
summary: At the Black Emperor Pavilion, Kui Cha, leader of the Kui Wolf Gang, confronts Xiao Yan over his men. Xiao Yan shows he is a Dou Huang, and Kui Cha backs down. When Kui Cha attacks Zi Yan, Mo Ya, Young Master of the Black Emperor Sect, steps in, and Little Fairy Doctor lets it go. She thinks Mo Ya set up the fight, and she quietly poisons him with the Soul Swallowing Flower. That night Demon Flame Valley men ask the gray-robed man to kill the Xiao Gate and Jia Nan Academy people in the city. Xiao Yan shuts himself away to refine the Zong Breaking Pill, a Sixth-Tier Pill, while Little Fairy Doctor and Zi Yan guard his room. After two days the pill is close to forming.
